documentation.subject: Store reconciliation has not completed for a day
documentation.content:
The hourly reconciliation sweep has recorded no completed run for twenty-six hours. Apple retries a notification for about a day and then stops, so a sweep that is not running is how a refund nobody heard about becomes a customer studying a deck they no longer own.

Written as an absence on purpose: a cron that stopped firing produces no failed run to notice, and `store_reconciliation_runs_total{outcome="failed"}` would stay at zero throughout.

Runbook: `docs/ops/commerce-reconciliation-runbook.md` and `docs/ops/deployment-runbooks.md`, "A scheduled job stopped running".

First two commands:

    gh run list --workflow 'Store reconciliation (dev)' --limit 10
    gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.event="store_reconciliation_finished"' --freshness 2d --limit 10 --format='value(timestamp,jsonPayload.environment,jsonPayload.runId)'

Stop conditions:

- If `gh run list` shows recent successful runs, the sweeps are happening and only the heartbeat write is failing. Check that `github-deployer` still holds `roles/logging.logWriter`; the API is unaffected and this is not an incident.
- If there are no runs at all, GitHub disabled the schedule — scheduled workflows are switched off after sixty days of repository inactivity. Re-enable it and dispatch one run by hand.
